  cell_counts: NULL
  filtered_reads: NULL
  raw_reads: NULL
  hs_metrics: NULL
  panel: NULL
format:
  html:

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)

#############
## load data
meth.matrix <- fread(params$meth)
cov.matrix <- fread(params$coverage)
cell.counts <- fread(params$cell_counts)
filtered.reads <- fread(params$filtered_reads)
raw.reads <- fread(params$raw_reads)
hs.metrics <- fread(params$hs_metrics)
panel <- fread(params$panel)

#############
## add 'chr' prefix to chromosomes
missing_prefix = !grepl("^chr",panel$chr)
if (any(missing_prefix))
  panel$chr[missing_prefix] <- paste0("chr",toupper(panel$chr))[missing_prefix]
panel$end <- panel$end + 1

#############
## reduce panel so non-overlapping intervals
reduce_intervals <- function(x) {
  stopifnot(all(c("chr","start","end") %in% colnames(x)))
  x <- x[order(x$chr,x$start,x$end),]
  y <- x[1,c("chr","start","end")]
  j <- 1
  for (i in 2:nrow(x)) {
    if (x$chr[i] != y$chr[j] || x$start[i] > y$end[j]) {
      y <- rbind(y, x[i,c("chr","start","end")])
      j <- j + 1
    }
    else
      y$end[j] <- max(y$end[j], x$end[i])
  }
  y
}
panel <- reduce_intervals(panel)

#############
## reformat cell.counts as a matrix
cell.types <- cell.counts[[1]]
cell.counts <- t(as.matrix(cell.counts[,-1]))
colnames(cell.counts) <- cell.types

#############
## prep filtered reads data (number for left and right paired ends the same)
setnames(filtered.reads, old = "Reads passing filters", new = "Reads")
colnames(filtered.reads) <- c("sample","reads")
filtered.reads$sample <- sub("(_R[12]|_[12])$", "", filtered.reads$sample)
filtered.reads <- unique(filtered.reads)

#############
## restrict methylation to panel regions
setkey(panel, chr, start, end)
setkey(meth.matrix ,  chr, start, end)
panel.meth <- foverlaps(meth.matrix, panel, type = "within", nomatch = 0L)
panel.cov  <- foverlaps(cov.matrix, panel, type = "within", nomatch = 0L)

#############
## restrict data matrices to just sample data (i.e. no genomic coordinates),
## to the same set of samples in the same order
sample.ids <- intersect(filtered.reads$sample, colnames(meth.matrix))
meth.matrix <- meth.matrix[,sample.ids, with=F]
cov.matrix <- cov.matrix[,sample.ids, with=F]
panel.meth <- panel.meth[,sample.ids, with=F]
panel.cov <- panel.cov[,sample.ids, with=F]

```
## Covered vs targeted CpG sites

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: covered-and-targeted-sites
#| results: asis

metrics <- c(
  "Covered CpG sites",
  "Targeted genomic regions",
  "Targeted and covered CpG sites",
  "Number of samples analysed",
  "Coverage threshold (mincov)"
)

descriptions <- c(
  "CpG sites in the human genome for which at least 50% of the samples each have at least 'mincov' reads covering the site.",
  "Number of targeted genomic regions",
  "Number of covered CpG sites inside targeted regions",
  "",
  ""
)

values <- format(
  c(nrow(meth.matrix),
    nrow(panel),
    nrow(panel.meth),
    ncol(panel.meth),
    10),
  big.mark=",")

row_html <- sprintf('<tr>
    <td style="padding:6px 10px;">
      %s<br>
      <span class="subdesc">%s</span>
    </td>
    <td style="padding:6px 10px; text-align:right;">%s</td>
  </tr>',
  metrics,
  descriptions,
  values)

table_html <- sprintf(
'<table class="metric-table">
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Metric</th><th style="text-align:right;">Value</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
  %s
  </tbody>
</table>
',
paste(row_html, collapse="\n"))


# CSS codes

css <- '
<style>
  /* Table size & typography */
  table.metric-table {
    width:90%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    font-size:0.95rem;

  }

  }

    padding:6px 10px;
    font-weight:600;
  }

  /* Data cells--white + gentle zebra striping */

    background:#ffffff;

    padding:6px 10px;
  }
  .metric-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background:#fafafa; }

  /* Description under each metric--darker & semi-bold */
  .metric-table .subdesc {
    font-style:italic;
    font-size:0.85em;
    color:#4a4a4a;
    font-weight:600;
  }
</style>
'

cat(css, table_html)
```

## DNA methylation distributions

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: dnam-distributions

meth.long = stack(panel.meth)
colnames(meth.long) <- c("dnam","sample")
  
ggplot(
  meth.long,
  aes(x=dnam, fill=sample, colour=sample)) + 
  geom_density(alpha=0.25, linewidth=0.6) +
  labs(title="",
       x="DNAm", 
       y="density") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

## Cell count estimates

```{r}  
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: false
#| label: cell-counts

getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))

long.counts <- stack(as.data.frame(cell.counts))
colnames(long.counts) <- c("count", "type")

iqr.counts <- data.frame(
  "q1"=round(apply(cell.counts, 2, quantile, probs=0.25, na.rm=T),2),
  "med"=round(apply(cell.counts, 2, quantile, probs=0.5, na.rm=T),2),
  "q3"=round(apply(cell.counts, 2, quantile, probs=0.75, na.rm=T),2))
iqr.counts$type <- rownames(iqr.counts)
  
ggplot(long.counts, aes(x=type, y=count, fill=type)) +
  geom_violin(
    alpha=0.25, 
    scale="width",
    trim=FALSE,
    position=position_dodge(width=0.5)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=getPalette(ncol(cell.counts))) +  
  geom_text(
    data=iqr.counts, aes(x=type, y=q3, label=paste0("Q3: ",q3)),
    position=position_nudge(x=0.2), size=3) + 
  geom_text(
    data=iqr.counts, aes(x=type, y=med, label=paste0("Median: ", med)), 
    position=position_nudge(x=0.2), size=3) +  
  geom_text(
    data=iqr.counts, aes(x=type, y=q1, label=paste0("Q1: ", q1)),
    position=position_nudge(x=0.2), size=3) +  
  theme_minimal(base_size=15) +  
  labs(
    x="cell type",
    y="count"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=8),
    axis.text.y=element_text(size=8),
    axis.title=element_text(size=10),
    plot.title=element_text(size=12, hjust=0.5),
    legend.position="none"  
  )

```

## Principal components analysis

```{r, include=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| label: pca

impute.matrix <- function(x, margin=1, fun=function(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)) {
    if (margin == 2) x <- t(x)
    idx <- which(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x), arr.ind=TRUE)
    if (length(idx) > 0) {
        na.idx <- unique(idx[,"row"])
        v <- apply(x[na.idx, , drop=FALSE], 1, fun)
        v[which(is.na(v))] <- fun(v)
        x[idx] <- v[match(idx[,"row"], na.idx)]
        stopifnot(all(!is.na(x)))
    }
    if (margin == 2) x <- t(x)
    x
}

meth.imputed <- impute.matrix(data.frame(panel.meth), 2)
meth.imputed <- meth.imputed[apply(meth.imputed,1,var) > 1e-25,]
pca.ret <- prcomp(t(meth.imputed), scale=T)
pca.dat <- data.frame(
  sample=colnames(meth.imputed),
  pca.ret$x,
  filtered.reads[match(colnames(panel.meth), filtered.reads$sample),])

pc.pairs <- list(
  c("PC1","PC2"),
  c("PC1","PC3"),
  c("PC2","PC3"))

pca.plots <- lapply(pc.pairs, function(pcs) {
  ggplot(pca.dat, aes_string(pcs[1], pcs[2], color="reads")) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_text(aes(label=sample), vjust=-0.5, hjust=0.5, size=3) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(color="read count") +                       
    scale_color_gradient(low="blue", high="red")
})
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: scree-plot
pcvar <- pca.ret$sdev^2
npcs <- min(20,length(pcvar))
scree.dat <- data.frame(
  comp=1:npcs,
  var=pcvar[1:npcs])
  
ggplot(scree.dat, aes(comp,var)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="steelblue") +
  labs(
    title="scree plot",
    x="principal components",
    y="variance") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: pc1-vs-pc2
print(pca.plots[[1]])
```
```{r}
#| echo: false

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

```

## Pairwise sample correlations

No DNAm scaling

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: sample-correlations

r <- cor(panel.meth, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
r.long <- stack(as.data.frame(r))
colnames(r.long) <- c("r","sample")

ggplot(r.long, aes(x=r)) +
  geom_density(fill="blue", alpha=0.5) +
  labs(x="correlation (R)", y="density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

After DNAm scaled

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: sample-correlations-after-scaling

meth.scaled <- t(scale(t(panel.meth)))
r <- cor(meth.scaled, use="pairwise.complete.obs")
r.long <- stack(as.data.frame(r))
colnames(r.long) <- c("r","sample")

ggplot(r.long, aes(x=r)) +
  geom_density(fill="blue", alpha=0.5) +
  labs(x="correlation (R)", y="density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Panel site coverage per sample

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: panel-site-coverage

pct.covered <- data.frame(
  sample=colnames(panel.meth),
  pct=apply(panel.meth,2,function(x) mean(!is.na(x))))
pct.covered <- pct.covered[order(pct.covered$pct),]
pct.covered$sample <- factor(pct.covered$sample, levels=pct.covered$sample)

ggplot(pct.covered, aes(x=sample)) +
  geom_col(aes(y=pct), fill="#2c7bb6") +
  labs(title="",
       x="sample", 
       y="% targeted sites") + 
  theme(
    axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x=element_blank())
```
